raw_posts.name: ScroogeFrog AI
raw_posts.tagline: AI ad fraud detection that protects your marketing budget
raw_posts.description: ScroogeFrog AI helps advertisers find out where their ad budget is going to waste. It audits website traffic and Google Ads campaigns to uncover suspicious clicks, bot activity, and underperforming spend, then turns complex data into clear recommendations on what to fix. For agencies and larger advertisers, it also offers custom AI fraud detection models trained on their own traffic data. Less guesswork, more control over every advertising dollar.

raw_posts.name: Nod by n8n
raw_posts.tagline: Open source personal agent with its own computer
raw_posts.description: Nod does the work around your work, in your apps and on real websites, using a private computer of its own on your Mac or PC. It takes orders only from you, asks before anything you didn't ask for, and runs on the AI provider you choose. Free, Apache 2.0.

raw_posts.name: CALL-E
raw_posts.tagline: Make phone calls with your AI agent (Muse, ChatGPT, Claude)
raw_posts.description: CALL-E lets your AI assistant make phone calls for you. Ask Muse, ChatGPT or Claude to book a table, get a quote, move an appointment or check stock. CALL-E asks for anything missing, shows you the plan, and dials a real US or Canadian number after you confirm. It gets through phone menus, hold and voicemail, then brings back a summary, the transcript and what happened. Builders can add it to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenClaw with one prompt. New users get 100 free credits.

raw_posts.name: Scribe v3 by ElevenLabs
raw_posts.tagline: Speech to text with 27% fewer errors in 90+ languages
raw_posts.description: Scribe v3 is ElevenLabs’ most accurate speech-to-text model, for developers building on calls, meetings, interviews and media. It makes 27% fewer word errors than Scribe v2 across 90+ languages. Unlike transcription that breaks on noise, accents and crosstalk, it labels up to 32 speakers, tags laughter, music and emotion, boosts up to 1,000 of your own terms, detects 56 entity types and handles files up to 15 hours. For live use, Scribe v3 Live runs under 150ms.

raw_posts.name: Skillbox
raw_posts.tagline: One library for your AI skills, synced to every agent
raw_posts.description: Skillbox keeps your AI skills in one library and syncs them to Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Follow GitHub sources, review diffs, and scan each version for prompt injection. Trim shortens noisy command output so sessions last longer.

raw_posts.name: MiniMax H3-Image
raw_posts.tagline: Bringing 4K image generation into the 10-second era
raw_posts.description: MiniMax H3-Image is an open-weight model for native 16MP image generation and editing. It uses just six diffusion steps, handles text-to-image and editing in one checkpoint, and supports up to 16 reference images.

raw_posts.name: Relay
raw_posts.tagline: DocSend for AI agents: send and receive docs with context
raw_posts.description: You send a deck or doc. They ask their AI to read it. The AI sees what's on the page, but not the thinking behind it: why you made those choices, what you left out, or what's still open. Relay shares that context with your document, so they and their AI can understand it and ask questions. You choose what to share. Decisions that need your input, like a discount or a date, come back to you. Try a sample relay. No sign-up needed.

raw_posts.name: Shot.video
raw_posts.tagline: Multi-camera videos with the phones you already own
raw_posts.description: Most people record with one camera, because more angles feel too hard. Shot.video turns your laptop and phones into a multi-camera studio. Scan a QR code and a phone becomes another camera, with no app to install. Press record once. Every angle records in sync, then AI makes your first edit. It cuts to the camera you're looking at and adds zooms, punch-ins and optional B-roll. Change anything you like. Free to start. No card needed.

raw_posts.name: Reddit Reviews
raw_posts.tagline: Product pages that collect subreddit sentiment
raw_posts.description: Discover Reddit Reviews, a new experience that organizes product conversations and highlights the most important takeaways from across our communities.

raw_posts.name: Muse Ember by Meta
raw_posts.tagline: Meta's low-cost AI model for high-volume agent tasks
raw_posts.description: Muse Ember is Meta's smallest multimodal reasoning model, built to handle the repetitive work behind AI agents. From tool calls and coding subtasks to document extraction and routing, Ember delivers efficient execution at scale. It supports text, images, audio, and video, with a 1M-token context window and pricing starting at $0.10 per million input tokens. Pair it with larger models for planning, and let Ember handle the volume. Available through Meta Model API and Muse Code.
